title: Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act 2009
text:
Tonga. No. 26 of 2009
I assent,
GEORGE TUPOU V,
1st June, 2009.
AN ACT
TO AMEND THE CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT
BE IT ENACTED by the King and Legislative Assembly of Tonga in the
Legislature of the Kingdom as follows:
1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act
2009.
(2) The Consumer Protection Act 2000 shall be referred to in this Act, as the
Principal Act.
2. Section 2 of the Principal Act is amended by inserting the following
definitions in the appropriate places:
“”National Biosafety Advisory Committee” means the National Biosafety
Advisory Committee established under section 5 of the Biosafety Act;”; and
“”living modified organism” has the same meaning as under the Biosafety
Act;”.
3. Section 12(2) of the Principal Act is amended by inserting the following
proviso:
“Provided that if a good is or contains a living modified organism the approved
standards applied to it shall comply with any standards or conditions set by the
National Biosafety Advisory Committee.”.
Passed in the Legislative Assembly this 29 day of October 2009.
